items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: And of course, I had known Fats for years anyway.

ctx.x: The magician, the magicians. And then Fats Waller band would come on for the capper. For the stopper. And of course, I had known Fats for years anyway. He was just too much. He was just beautiful.
Which reminds me, I threw something away I didn't mean to. This week his son had a memorial in the newspaper on the anniversary of his father's death.
